concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work. Compiler-emitted structures are fresh and owned by the caller; the volatile run envelope is the only per-call value and never enters the plan body.
inputs: declared time quantities, tolerances, durations and numeric parameters
note: Successor revision. Adds the count-based bound negative surface: max_parameters (per-payload, total compiled, declared core, plus the at-bound positive), max_steps, max_faults, max_observers, max_metrics, max_dependencies_per_step, max_flows, max_bindings, max_resources, max_text_length, max_bytes_per_file and max_diagnostics. max_ticks, max_seed and max_number_magnitude keep their existing quantity/seed/parameter negatives; max_limitations is negatively covered by XDL1-SR-012-U.
purpose: Validate every declared quantity, duration and bound against explicit units and finite library limits, rejecting non-finite, negative or overflow values and ambiguous units. Enforce every declared finite library bound over its complete frozen scope, including the total compiled-parameter scope of detailed-design.md section 10.3, and require at least one independent negative case per count-based bound. Resolves XDL1-RVW-001 and XDL1-RVW-003.
state: Stateless unit conversion through the closed vocabulary and finite-bound enforcement.

static_checks.expected: literal inspection shows the frozen mapping and max_ticks == 9007199254740991
static_checks.rule: TIME_UNIT_TICKS and ExperimentLimits defaults match the frozen design table and are all positive
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse, jsonschema meta-schema validation, additive diff scope check)
